purpose: Zero-inference recorded native CI coverage only. This is not live evaluation selection, holdout grading or score imputation.
timing_disclosure: The root agent assigned this fixed coverage rule after holdout inference started. Before this file was written, an audit agent communicated two width-patch residual descriptions. No holdout artifact was opened for this rule, and neither descriptions nor outcomes changed the rule. This is a CI coverage policy, not a preregistered holdout efficacy analysis.

development.include: All24 natively accepted, independently closed selected assertion-grounded-v7 development cases.

holdout.include: For each of21 frozen held-out case IDs, take the earliest accepted selected trial in registered round order r1 then r2 then r3. Finish all registered trials and independent reviews before finalizing the index.
holdout.acceptance: Original score success=true/status=published, native/Git/protected-source/publication verification passed, independent functional review closed with no confirmed functional contract regression. Preserve any separate quality observations.
holdout.no_accepted_trial: Omit the case from CI recordings and list the coverage gap. Do not impute success, rerun, replace a trial or change original scores.

windows.chrono_pre_epoch_excluded: MSVC gmtime_s does not support the negative calendar range required by the pinned chrono suite.

analysis_separation: Replay runs consume saved actual Luna responses and make zero live model calls.
Raw live first-round and repeat native scores remain unchanged, including failures and pre-inference safe stops.
Selecting an accepted recording for CI coverage is not evidence that the corresponding first live trial succeeded.
Repeated selected live trials remain21 unique held-out defects; CI replay adds no unique defects or live inference trials.
bytes_policy: Export and commit exact recorded metadata, requests, responses, events and schemas with SHA256 hashes; never rewrite model packets or provenance.
